render_camera_meshes_over_epochs: run the render_root script to render camera meshes over training epochs as a video
render_mesh_only_mode: run render_root with mesh_only flag to render only the rest mesh in gray
render_with_frame_cap: run render_root with cap_frame to limit the number of rendered frames
render_with_frame_range: run render_root with first_idx and last_idx to render a specific frame range
render_cameras_to_gif_and_mp4: run render_root to generate both gif and mp4 videos of camera mesh visualization
